risk_note: B1-08zza (orders, RV2; BR-ATTR-08 / BR-ATTR-09; PDD A' implementation 1, owner agreed 2026-11-25, D10-2970 item 6; transitional rule D10-3278). A pdd order that carries lk is classified by the link the server registered (same app, same user, same item by goods_sign then product_key, link created_at <= paid_at in milliseconds) -> the link's pid_scene, scene_basis=link; otherwise self / fallback; an order without lk keeps the promotion-slot rule through the rule-table field missingLinkBuyTypeBasis (pdd 'pid', jd / taobao null). The order row and the first commission snapshot use the same decision; source backfill reuses the one link read. Migrations 0159 (orders_scene_basis_check rebuilt NOT VALID with link) / 0160 (VALIDATE), precedent 0081 / 0082; 0159 is pinned in APPROVED_GUARD_CHANGES by guard-change B1-08zzb, merged first. Snapshot regenerated on couli-ci (main copy byte-identical). Money r1 S0 (second-precision pay time) closed by orchestrator ruling D10-3384 (frozen [AC-B1-08zza#10], FU-PDD-PAY-TIME-SECOND).
